mapper.insert: INSERT INTO miraero_user ( name, birth_date, company_name, monthly_income, email, password_hash, kb_pay_id ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{companyName}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{kbPayId} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, company_name AS companyName, monthly_income AS monthlyIncome, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, kb_pay_id AS kbPayId, created_at AS createdAt FROM miraero_user WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT user_id AS userId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, company_name AS companyName, monthly_income AS monthlyIncome, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, kb_pay_id AS kbPayId, created_at AS createdAt FROM miraero_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id, name, email, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS birthDate, company_name AS company, monthly_income, CASE WHEN kb_pay_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS kbpayLinked FROM miraero_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
